This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The BOM prefix in CSV exports is intentional and configurable: src/export/csv.ts defines a `bom` option (defaulting to true) specifically so spreadsheet apps can detect UTF-8 when a file is opened directly. It's unclear from the code alone whether there's currently a user-facing way (API parameter or settings toggle) to set bom:false, versus it only being a code-level default.
